author: ruixen.ui
name: product-bounce-card
description: The ProductBounceCard is a sleek, animated display card designed to showcase products with a lively and modern 3D bounce effect. Using Framer Motion, it smoothly animates the product image with gentle vertical movement and subtle Y-axis rotation, creating a floating illusion that grabs attention. A soft shadow beneath the image adds depth and realism, making the product appear as if it’s hovering above the surface. Perfect for e-commerce landing pages, featured items, or hero sections, the ProductBounceCard brings your product visuals to life with engaging motion and clean design.
